scope: Original game code plus explicitly modeled host disc policies; no recovered-firmware claim. Full machine/RAM/boundaries, software peripheral effects, disc ownership/progress and every host transport attempt match.
limitations: Runtime filesystem/directory/driver tables remain explicit fixtures; natural mount/boot ordering is not yet proved.
Native sector-per-pump, status, cancellation, drive identity and coherent cache policies are host platform choices, not decompiled BIOS or cycle-accurate devices.
Large cache paths stop at their missing uncached aliases; asynchronous hardware, gameplay and all ports/settings remain unfinished.
